sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: About 0.9 s after the event; broadband music onset, not tied to a visual change.

pattern.description: The agent's refusal lands in the Conversation Preview and the chat thread scrolls up inside its fixed panel; at the same moment the left reasoning trace swaps to the new plan (Inappropriate_Content topic, Agent Response step).
pattern.why_premium: Two synced panels update together on the narration's 'respond to requests', so the viewer sees the answer and the reasoning that produced it in one beat without a cut or a camera move.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline at t=0: gsap.fromTo(chatThread, {y: 0}, {y: -replyHeight, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out'}) with gsap.fromTo(refusal, {autoAlpha: 0, y: 12}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out'}); near the end (~0.35 s) tl.set(traceOld, {display: 'none'}).set(traceNew, {display: 'block'}) for the instant left-panel swap.
build_hint.remotion: Chat wrapper translateY = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 170}}), [0, 1], [0, -replyHeight]); refusal opacity on the same spring; render the old trace before frame ~10 and the new trace after it (hard switch, no interpolation).

notes: camera.move is none. The left trace panel appears to switch content in one frame (around f1744) rather than animate; its boxes are listed as content swaps. The pattern could also read as a two-panel sync update; masked_scroll picked for the chat motion.
